articles.headline: Google unveils Gemini 3.7 Flash for coding and agent workflows
articles.summary: Google launched Gemini 3.7 Flash, a new AI model aimed at software coding and automated business tasks. For companies, the key implication is faster AI-assisted development and workflow automation, which could reduce software delivery time and improve productivity, even though Google did not disclose timing for a flagship Pro release.

articles.headline: Flock adds police auditing and accountability controls after surveillance scrutiny
articles.summary: Flock introduced new safety controls in response to concerns about surveillance and police misuse of its technology. For businesses that buy or deploy monitoring, security, or workplace tracking tools, the story highlights rising compliance and reputational risk around data use and oversight.

articles.headline: CoreWeave shares jump as revenue doubles and backlog hits $104 billion
articles.summary: CoreWeave’s surge signals that demand for AI cloud capacity remains intense, even as investors worry about infrastructure constraints and bubble risk. For businesses, this points to continued pressure on AI compute availability and pricing, especially for companies building AI products or buying large amounts of cloud capacity.
